name: ComiXed
description: ComiXed is a digital comic library management tool. Its underlying goal is to enable users to manage the contents of their library and to access that library from any device that supports OPDS. (Exert from comixed Wiki. Accessed 08.11.2021 (https://github.com/comixed/comixed/wiki)) Read this! Readme: https://github.com/comixed/comixed/blob/master/README.md Quickstart: https://github.com/comixed/comixed/blob/master/QUICKSTART.md After container start wait a bit, as it has a bit of Overhead. Default accounts are to be found in the Quickstart entry. The Docker is currently a bit buggy. Be sure to update the root library location to /library and add an ComicVine api key under Administration -> Configuration before adding any comics. Access to opds: (ServerIP):(DockerPort)/opds
